name: @smartpos/desktop
description: SmartPOS Electron React desktop demo with durable local SQLite v1 schema (no checkout yet)

scripts.test:security: pnpm run security:check && pnpm run test:security-shell && pnpm run test:storage-security && pnpm run test:receipt-boundary && pnpm run test:outbox-boundary && pnpm run test:catalog-pull:boundary && pnpm run test:sales-report:boundary
scripts.package:demo:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage-demo.mjs && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.18.1 --projectDir .demo-package --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-demo-artifacts.mjs win x64
scripts.package:demo:mac:x64: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage-demo.mjs && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.18.1 --projectDir .demo-package --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-demo-artifacts.mjs mac x64
scripts.package:demo:mac:arm64: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage-demo.mjs && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.18.1 --projectDir .demo-package --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-demo-artifacts.mjs mac arm64
